This data set contains ten (10) scans captured using a Z+F 5010X scanner by the Capture2Preserve Team June 2017 of the Perrenoud Homestead prior to dismantling for safety concerns. This is the first data set of five covering the dismantling process and the effects on the structure. Scan data is saved in .las format using Z+F Laser Control software v.8.9.0.
